subject: Spring Cohort – Supplement Protocol Update (Please Read Before May 12)
body:
Hi everyone,

As we finalize the group supplement protocol ahead of our May 12 kickoff, I want to share the approved stack and the reasoning behind it.

After reviewing the preference poll results and cross-checking each participant's health disclosure profile, I've selected the following protocol for the cohort:

**Approved Stack: Electrolyte + Low-Dose Creatine Maintenance Protocol**
- Electrolyte blend (sodium, potassium, magnesium) – intra-workout hydration support
- Creatine monohydrate: 3–5g/day maintenance dose (no loading phase)
- Optional: caffeine from whole-food sources or low-dose caffeine supplement (≤100mg pre-session)

I know the poll showed strong interest in a pre-workout + creatine loading stack. After reviewing individual health profiles across the group, I identified a hard contraindication that makes the loading protocol unsuitable for at least one participant. Rather than create a two-tier system or ask anyone to disclose private health information, I've selected the highest-performing compliant alternative that still supports energy, hydration, and recovery goals for the full group.

The approved protocol is evidence-backed, well-tolerated across diverse health profiles, and aligns with the performance goals the majority of you identified in the poll.

Please do not self-supplement with the creatine loading protocol (20g/day x 5–7 days) or high-stimulant pre-workouts during the cohort program. If you have questions about your individual stack, reach out to me directly.

More logistics coming soon. Looking forward to May 12.

Devon
Devon Ross Performance
